en.bdb: The true conduct as way to liberation

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰ ਕਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰਾਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: nira(n)kaar aakaar kar satigur guraa(n) guroo abinaasee|

en.bdb: The formless One has assumed form as the true Guru (Nanak Dev) who is the eternal Guru of the Gurus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪੀਰਾਂ ਪੀਰ ਵਖਾਣੀਐ ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਵਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: peeraa(n) peer vakhaaneeaai naathaa(n) naath saadhasa(n)g vaasee|

en.bdb: He is known as the pir of pirs(Muslim spiritualists) and that Master of masters resides in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪੰਥ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਸਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh pa(n)th chalaiaa gursikh maiaa vich udhaasee|

en.bdb: He promulgated gurmukh panth, the way of Gurmukhs, and the Sikhs of the Guru remain detached even in maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਚ ਆਖੀਅਨਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪੰਚ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਪਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: sanamukh mil pa(n)ch aakheean biradh pa(n)ch paramesur paasee|

en.bdb: Those present themselves before the Guru are known as panches (the eminent ones) and the reputation of such panches  is protected by the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪਰਵਾਣ ਪੰਚ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚਖੰਡ ਬਿਲਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh mil paravaan pa(n)ch saadhasa(n)gat sachakha(n)dd bilaasee|

en.bdb: Meeting the Gurmukhs such panches  get accepted and move happily in the holy congregation, the abode of truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਦਰਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਹੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਹਰਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: gur dharasan gur sabadh hai nij ghar bhai bhagat raharaasee|

en.bdb: The word of the Guru is the glimpse of the Guru and getting settled in one's own self, the discipline of loving devotion is observed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਠਾ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਨਿਵ ਚਲਣੁ ਖਟਿ ਖਵਾਲਣੁ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: miThaa bolan niv chalan khaT khavaalan aas niraasee|

en.bdb: This discipline consists in sweet speech, humble conduct, honest labour, hospitality and in remaining detached among hopes and disappointments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਹੈ ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੀ।
verses.translit_en: sadhaa sahaj bairaag hai kalee kaal a(n)dhar paragaasee|

en.bdb: Living in equi­poise and indifference is true renunciation in the Kaliyug, the dark age.
Meeting the holy congregation only, one gets liberated from the cycle of transmigration
